scenario: Onboarding Form Submitted → GHL + Drive + Discord
description: Fires when a new client completes the onboarding intake form. Make.com updates the GHL contact with form answers, stores responses in the client's Drive folder, posts a summary to the staff Discord onboarding channel, and optionally sends a confirmation email to the client.

payload.name: string — client's full name
payload.phone: string | null — phone number if provided
payload.responses: object — key-value map of form field names to answers
payload.driveFolderUrl: string | null — URL to the client's onboarding Drive folder
payload.ghlContactId: string | null — GHL contact ID if already created

makeSteps: Step 1: Receive webhook — parse form responses
Step 2: Update GHL contact custom fields with onboarding answers
Step 3: Create a Google Doc in the client's onboarding Drive folder with form responses
Step 4: Post summary embed to staff Discord onboarding-alerts channel
Step 5: Send confirmation email to client via Gmail or GHL campaign
